recommendedNextStep.afterPreparation: Require source-bound fixture receipt, unchanged configured IME component/UID, bounded post-launch unique-PID readiness and actual /proc PID/UID/start-time/cmdline identity before any profiler start. Preserve all initial unavailable observations. Do not relaunch or add shows on a failed readiness check.
recommendedNextStep.profilingContract: Retain the existing unfiltered complete AMS empty-slot preflight, single start, ownership rechecks, guarded single stop, file identity/format checks, original failure retention and native/host time limits. The one-second hold is not the entire native tracing duration.
